Docket 1.3.143

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A mistyped address is refused, not scored.* `docket audit "not a url"` crawled nothing, scored it 0 with every
  area "not applicable" and exited 0, as if the run had passed. An address with a space, a broken port or no host
  is now refused before any crawl, with exit code 1 and an example of the right form. localhost, bare IP
  addresses and `http://devbox:8000` style hosts still work.
- *The free command line quotes the Black Friday price.* Without a key, the footer said "$59 once, or 4 x $14.75"
  all through the sale. It now gives the sale price and its code, then the price after it, from the same offer the
  app shows.
- *"This computer", not "This Mac".* Activation and release messages said "Mac", on Windows too. One licence covers
  up to 3 computers at a time, Mac or Windows, and the messages now say "computer".

99 checks across 13 areas.
